idea-plugin.name: Nomo
idea-plugin.description: Nomo language support for JetBrains IDEs: diagnostics, completion, hover, workspace symbols, go-to-definition, references, rename, quick fixes, formatting and semantic highlighting powered by the nomo-lsp language server through LSP4IJ.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: Initial Nomo language support with native highlighting and nomo-lsp integration.

server.name: Nomo Language Server
server.description: Nomo language server (nomo-lsp). Provides diagnostics, completion, hover, workspace symbols, go-to-definition, references, rename, quick fixes, formatting and semantic tokens for .nomo files.
